questions.question: David thanked the LORD for upholding his just cause. How did David picture the LORD?

answers.text: As a judge on His throne judging righteously
As a soldier at the front leading the charge
As a shepherd in the field guarding the flock

questions.question: In David's psalm, the nations dug a pit and hid a net. Who ended up caught in it?
A psalm describes a proud wicked man. What does he say to himself about God?

answers.text: God has forgotten and never sees
God is fighting on his side
